04287 Machath {makh'-ath}

可能源自 04229; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Mahath 3; 3

瑪哈 = "握住"

1) 哥轄家的利未人 (#代上 6:35; 代下29:12|)
2) 希西家時代，哥轄家的利未人 (#代下 31:13|)

04287 Machath {makh'-ath}

probably from 04229;; n pr m

AV - Mahath 3; 3

Mahath = "grasping"

2) a Kohathite Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah
